New message in #sales:

mike: does anyone know the current MRR for Acme Corp?

input.text: Hi Mike! I don't have access to any CRM/billing data or a tool to look up account MRR, so I can't pull that for you. You'd want to check your CRM (e.g., the account record for Acme Corp) or pull it from your billing/subscription system. If someone on the team can point me to where that lives, happy to help from there.

content.text: I responded to Mike. I don't have any data-lookup tools available (only the ability to post messages), so I let him know I can't pull MRR and pointed him to the CRM/billing system. If you'd like, you can point me to a tool or data source for this kind of query and I can handle it next time.
